extraction_notes: The supplied six-page PDF identifies BLM3401 as a P-channel enhancement-mode power MOSFET from BL Shanghai Belling, revision V2.0, in an SOT-23 package.

P-channel voltage and current values in tabulated electrical characteristics retain the signed values printed in the datasheet. Resistance and capacitance values use positive SI quantities. Figures 5, 7, 10, 11, and 12 plot positive magnitudes, which are preserved as plotted and identified in each curve condition.

Figures 5, 7, 10, 11, and 12 contain usable typical traces. Listed curve points are sparse direct manual readings from the plotted traces, rounded to compact values; no unplotted points were invented or interpolated.

The datasheet publishes IDSS maximum -1 uA at VDS = -24 V and VGS = 0 V, IGSS maximum +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-20 V and VDS = 0 V, and gFS typical 10 S at VDS = -5 V and ID = -4.2 A. These fields are outside the strict MOSFET extraction schema.

The datasheet publishes typical Qg = 9.5 nC, Qgs = 2 nC, and Qgd = 3 nC. Qgs and Qgd are specified at VDS = -15 V, ID = -4 A, and VGS = -4.5 V; the Qg row is typical and shares the gate-charge test context. These fields are outside the strict MOSFET extraction schema.
The datasheet publishes RthetaJA maximum 104 degC/W for surface mounting on FR4 with t <= 10 s, but no RthetaJC. Thermal data is outside the strict MOSFET extraction schema.
No body-diode reverse-recovery trr or Qrr value is published. No numerical RDS(on)-versus-temperature table is published, although normalized and temperature curves are shown.
